description: Update the progress of a memo with a status change and message. Writes progress to .md-feedback/progress.json and updates the memo status. Terminal statuses (done, failed) require human approval via VS Code.

file.description: Path to the annotated markdown file

memoId.description: The memo ID to update progress for

message.description: Progress message describing what was done or what failed

status.description: New progress status. Terminal statuses (done, failed) require human approval via VS Code.

name: update_memo_progress
